verdict.rationale: Official docs show Gazebo Sim runs headless with the `-s` server-only flag. A dedicated gz-sim-server package installs the server without any GUI or Qt dependencies, which suits slim CI images. Command-line tools support introspection and control, and Gazebo Transport lets the simulation run on remote servers. Missing for 10: CI-specific guidance (e.g., pipeline examples, run-for-N-iterations/auto-exit usage, headless sensor rendering), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI use.
